title: Dropdown Menu
description: A dropdown menu is a floating list of actions opened by a trigger — buttons, icons, or avatars — so users can run commands without leaving the page.

title: Select
description: A select is a form control that lets users choose one option from a closed list. A trigger shows the current value, and a dropdown panel reveals the choices.

title: Sheet
description: A sheet is a slide-out panel that enters from an edge of the screen — top, right, bottom, or left — to present supplementary content, forms, or actions without navigating away.

title: Drawer
description: A drawer is a sliding panel that enters from an edge of the screen — bottom, top, left, or right — to present supplementary content or actions without navigating away.

title: Alert
description: An alert is an inline status banner that surfaces important feedback — success, warning, error, or neutral information — without blocking the page.

title: Timeline
description: A timeline is a vertical sequence of events along a shared axis — markers, timestamps, and descriptions that make chronological order easy to scan.

title: Time Input
description: A time input is a native form field that uses the browser's built-in time picker via type="time" — compact, accessible, and ideal for simple time-of-day entry.

title: Date Input
description: A date input is a native form field that uses the browser's built-in date picker via type="date" compact, accessible, and ideal for simple single-date entry.

title: Date Picker
description: A date picker is a form field that opens a calendar popover for choosing a single date or range — combining a trigger, formatted label, and month grid.

title: Calendar
description: A calendar is a date grid for browsing months and selecting days — single dates, ranges, or multiple days — often embedded in forms and popovers.

title: Tabs
description: Tabs organize related content into labeled panels, showing one section at a time while keeping every option visible in a trigger row.

title: Carousel
description: A carousel is a UI component that displays a series of images or content in a scrollable area. It is commonly used to showcase products, images, or other content in a visually appealing way.

title: Accordion
description: An accordion is a UI component that displays a series of content in a vertically stacked list. It is commonly used to showcase products, images, or other content in a visually appealing way.

title: Breadcrumb
description: A breadcrumb is a UI component that displays a series of content in a horizontally stacked list. It is commonly used to showcase products, images, or other content in a visually appealing way.

title: Card
description: A card is a UI component that displays a series of content in a horizontally stacked list. It is commonly used to showcase products, images, or other content in a visually appealing way.

title: Dialog
description: A dialog is a modal surface that appears above the page to capture focused attention for a task, decision, or message.
